people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
translations.bsb: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
